docs.title: Personal settings and channels
docs.text:
• @settings saves display/chat preferences for the account and restores them on login. Configure these preferences through the menu.
  • Song muting silences subsequent Bard/Dancer song audio while keeping musical notes and ground effects. Turning muting Off restores the audio.
  • Existing and new players automatically join #main, #recruit and #market. Saved channel Off choices remain respected.
  • Storage withdrawal limits and farming/storage lists are saved per character.

Personal settings guide

docs.title: Advanced autoloot
docs.text:
• @lootconfig and @settings > Autoloot open the same saved configuration.
  • Main Autoloot uses the original database drop chance, with a threshold from 0-100% and up to two decimal places.
  • Ignore up to 100 item IDs and create 40 groups of 100 items, with one active group at a time.
  • Active-group items override the ignore list and can be collected while Main Autoloot is Off.
  • Main Autoloot at 100% with Jellopy #909 ignored leaves it on the ground, provided it is not in the active group. Manual pickup remains available.
  • Fixed the disconnect/server-unavailable issue associated with ignored ground drops and pickup.

Advanced autoloot guide

docs.title: Restock and Quick Store
docs.text:
• Added 40 groups of 40 items per type, saved per character. One Restock and one Quick Store group can be active independently.
  • Configure through @settings > Restock Supplies / Quick Store, or @restockconfig / @qstoreconfig.
  • @restock refills inventory up to saved target totals, from 1-30,000 per item. It remains strictly below 90% weight and respects a lower personal withdrawal limit.
  • @qstore deposits all eligible inventory units of the listed item IDs. No quantity or Keep value is configured. Add Jellopy #909 to deposit all eligible Jellopy.
  • Existing Quick Store lists keep their names, item IDs and active choices; previous Keep amounts are discarded.
  • Transfers require Main Storage already open in a town, including Midgard Expedition Camp, Manuk and Splendide. Consumables, stackable miscellaneous items, loose cards and loose ammunition are supported. Normal capacity and item protections remain.

Fast storage guide

docs.title: Kill Count
docs.text:
• @kc / @killcount detect the last credited monster when no tracking target is active. Start confirmation is required; opening or cancelling the menu changes nothing.
  • Only one monster type is actively tracked, with no five-slot list. While active, @kc opens that monster's summary; an explicit monster ID can propose a replacement.
  • Private overhead messages show Hill Wind kills: 6,409, without a character-name prefix.
  • Summaries show Total kills, Kills without card, Cards dropped, and the active Tracked kills count.
  • Stop and Reset affect the overhead counter, preserving recorded history. The selected monster persists per character; its tracked count restarts on login.
  • Card statistics count actual generated drops, including cards left on the ground. Companion kills credit their owner.

Kill Count guide

docs.title: Card Drop Announcements
docs.text:
• Shortened the message to Tubbs has obtained their 1st [Lude Card] on the 559th kill.
  • Credit the successful recipient after normal pickup, autoloot or pet delivery. Pet-collected cards credit the owner.
  • Party-shared cards and cards collected from somebody else's kill show the received-copy ordinal without a kill count.
  • Each receipt creates a single Public-filtered event, respecting @settings > Announcement Config > Drop.
  • Received-copy counters, Kill Count's generated-card statistics and personal card artwork remain separate.

Card Drop Announcements guide

docs.title: Kill Steal Protection
docs.text:
• @noks and @settings > Kill Steal Protection open the same saved mode menu. Default Party, saved per character.
  • Self allows only the owner and their companions; Party or Guild allows the matching group. Protection can also be disabled.
  • Locks begin on eligible monster targeting or positive damage from outside aggro range. There is no protected-monster count limit.
  • Release after 5 seconds of owner inactivity, 15 seconds from the first unauthorized attempt, or 30 seconds from the initial lock. Attacks, skills and movement count as activity; chat does not.
  • Repeated attacks do not refresh the contest deadline or hard cap, and a released encounter does not immediately re-lock.
  • @nokscheck privately lists party modes and marks unavailable/offline members unchecked.
  • MVPs, Boss-mode mini-bosses, native slaves, towns and AllowKS/PvP/GvG/Battleground maps are excluded.

Kill Steal Protection guide

docs.title: Trade search aliases
docs.text:
Added command Existing equivalent @whosell @ws @whosell2 @ws2 @whobuy @wb @whobuy2 @wb2

All four long names are available to ordinary players and use the existing item-name/ID, refine and price filters. Window/text behavior, cooldowns and town-only remote trading stay the same. The vending recap remains its existing totals summary.

Vendor search guide

docs.title: Handbook organization
docs.text: The wiki now uses Welcome, Getting Started, Features & Enhancements, Dungeons & Instances, Events & Activities, and Patch Notes, with nested feature/change/enhancement guides and an All Pages directory.

docs.title: Homunculus and pet commands
docs.text:
The four existing companion commands are now available to ordinary players, including new accounts:

  • @hominfo: current homunculus HP/SP, combat stats, hunger and intimacy.
  • @homstats: homunculus growth stats and possible ranges.
  • @homtalk <message>: speak through an active homunculus.
  • @pettalk <message>: speak or use supported emotes through an active pet.

Companion speech and supported pet emotes are logged under the owning character and account. Player chat mutes and normal configured chat-delay checks still apply.

@settings > Mute Pets / Hide Pets now also filter pet speech and pet emotes for each viewer. Homunculus speech and player chat remain unaffected.

Homunculus and Pet Commands guide | Personal Settings

docs.title: Welcome to Vestige Rift
docs.text:
The server and player handbook now use the name Vestige Rift.

Some worlds don’t end. They come back different.

docs.title: Independent baby characters
docs.text:
• Added Sister Elara for independent baby conversion. See Baby Characters for her current location.
  • Eligible regular Novices and first classes, including Ninja, Taekwon, Gunslinger and Super Novice, can convert for 5,000,000z without adoption.
  • Conversion preserves Base/Job Levels, EXP, skills and allocated stats. Normal baby equipment restrictions apply; the maximum base stat remains 99.
  • Second and later classes, transcended characters, existing babies and adopted/pending-adoption characters cannot use the service.
  • Baby first classes can advance while remaining babies. The Star Gladiator and Soul Linker quests now recognize Baby Taekwon.
  • Babies cannot transcend or become adults through job changes.
  • Baby Novice is permanently unable to change class, including to Super Baby. The NPC requires an additional confirmation before taking payment.
  • Cancelling is free; a successful conversion charges the fee once. The conversion persists after relogging.

Baby Characters guide

docs.title: Build Manager
docs.text:
• Added the Build Manager; the guide lists its current Main Office location.
  • Each character can keep ten stat builds and ten separate skill builds, saved across relogs.
  • Saving, overwriting, renaming and deleting are free. Loading either build type costs 5,000z, after confirmation and validation.
  • Skill builds are deleted after a class change. Stat builds hide below their saved Base Level and reappear when that level is reached again.
  • Loading preserves character levels and EXP, leaves extra points unspent, validates current point budgets and prerequisites, and retains permanent platinum skills.
  • Normal skill-reset effects and ranked-Taekwon restrictions still apply.

docs.title: Adjusted NPC sell prices
docs.text:
Selected items now pay less Zeny when sold to NPCs. The update covers 82 table entries across 86 item IDs, including ordinary equipment variants.

The aim is to reduce Zeny creation from high-volume farming, encourage a wider choice of hunting activities and reduce the return from automated farming. These changes support a healthier trading economy; they do not replace other measures against abuse.

  • Crystal Blue (#991): 500z to 250z, our server-specific choice.
  • All listed prices are base resale values; Merchant Overcharge still applies normally.
  • NPC purchase prices, drop rates, item effects and restrictions retain their existing behavior.
  • Same-name quest, rental and alternate consumable items are excluded unless explicitly listed by ID.

The Adjusted NPC sell prices guide contains the full previous/current table and explains the balancing goals. Supply purchase prices remain in Convenient Dealers.

docs.title: Expanded Card Exchange rewards
docs.text:
Putty at /navi main_office 136/32 now offers 14 rewards, adding 13 choices while retaining Bloody Branch.

  • Life Insurance: 5 points.
  • JOB Battle Manual and Battle Manual: 8 points each.
  • Giant Fly Wing Box (10 wings): 7 points per box.
  • Bubble Gum and Gym Pass: 55 points each.
  • The six 30-minute +10 stat foods: 65 points each.
  • Old Card Album: 95 points.
  • Bloody Branch remains 120 points.

The exchange still grants 10 account-wide card points per accepted card. Eligibility protections, purchase confirmation and inventory-capacity checks remain in effect. Poring Coin is not offered.

See the illustrated Card Exchange catalogue for exact item IDs, food stats and reward variants.

docs.title: Vestige Coin System
docs.text:
• Added Vestige Coin (#35363), a zero-weight, unbound and tradable currency.
  • Eligible monster deaths have a fixed 5% chance to drop one coin. Familiar, Female/Male Thief Bug and Orc Zombie use 1%; listed eggs, plants and low-risk species are excluded.
  • Server rates, Bubble Gum and other modifiers do not increase coin chances.
  • Existing quests and events have not been changed to grant coins.

See Vestige Coin System for the full exception list, loot rules and Autoloot setup.

docs.title: Lydia's Vestige Coin Exchange
docs.text:
• Added Lydia at prt_in 38,108, using the item-currency exchange window.
  • Added 26 rewards at the approved Vestige Coin prices, including manuals, scrolls, supply boxes, potions, Gym Passes, Bloody Branch and reusable wings.
  • Added Infinite Butterfly Wing (#35364), which returns to the saved point without being consumed and retains normal map/duel restrictions.
  • Kafra Card boxes contain ten Main Storage cards. Life Insurance protects every death during its 30-minute effect.

See the illustrated Vestige Coin Exchange catalogue.

docs.title: Shared Bubble Gum adjustment
docs.text: Bubble Gum (#12210) now grants +150% item drops for 30 minutes, replacing +200%. Lydia and Putty offer the same item: 1,000 Vestige Coins or 55 card points, respectively. Existing copies use the revised effect when consumed. Vestige Coin drops remain fixed.

docs.title: Area Loot
docs.text:
• Added @arealoot and @settings > Area Loot (3x3).
  • A successful clicked pickup also tries eligible ground items in the 3x3 square centered on that item, including diagonals.
  • The setting is Off by default and saved per character.
  • Normal ownership, party sharing, weight and inventory limits remain in effect. The pickup square does not chain to other areas.
  • Area Loot is manual pickup and is independent of Autoloot ignore lists.

See Area Loot.

docs.title: Mercy System
docs.text:
• Added an automatic guarantee after 5,000 eligible kills of the same normal monster without its card dropping.
  • Progress persists per character and monster ID; existing recorded cardless streaks count toward the threshold.
  • Natural or guaranteed card drops reset the streak, even when the card remains on the ground or goes to a party member.
  • Natural drops take priority, preventing an extra guaranteed copy on the same kill.
  • MVPs, mini-bosses and ineligible summons are excluded.
  • Mercy progress appears in @kc / @killcount. Resetting the visible tracker does not reset Mercy.

See Mercy System for credit, exclusions and delivery rules.

docs.title: Refining System
docs.text:
• All standard equipment refiners and Suhnbi offer Classic or Visual refining.
  • Classic: normal ores only, equipped gear, and single/safe-limit/target-level refining. Bulk orders charge only attempted upgrades and stop on failure or insufficient resources.
  • Visual: enriched ores only, inventory selection, shown success chances and one animated attempt at a time. Each attempt costs one ore and 2,000z.
  • Both interfaces keep Pre-Renewal rules and the +10 cap. Failure destroys the equipment. HD ores are not offered.
  • Standardized enriched ores on Oridecon #7620 and Elunium #7619. Existing duplicate ores were converted with quantities preserved, leaving one catalyst option per equipment type.

See Refining System for both success-rate tables, fees and NPC locations.

docs.title: Handbook updates
docs.text: Added categorized guides for the new systems, refreshed today's release notes and homepage, and added the supplied Vestige Rift banner. Removed testing-status reports from public guides and older release notes so those pages focus on player rules and usage.

docs.title: Bio Labs 4
docs.text:
Bio Labs 4 is now open as an adapted Classic Pre-Renewal party dungeon.

  • Retuned all 21 regular, elite and MVP monster profiles around our 99/70 rules and Bio3 baseline.
  • Reduced the regular population to 196 monsters, with 15-second respawns. Regulars are level 96-98; elites and MVPs are level 99.
  • Added classic class-based skill profiles and corrected MVP reward classification.
  • Restored the Bio3 entrance at lhz_dun03 239,78 and the return portal at lhz_dun04 244,61.
  • Removed Renewal drops, including Bio4 cards, Bradium and Carnium; retained classic-compatible items and reduced box/album chances for our rates. No direct Bio4 cards means no Mercy card guarantee here.
  • Kept Warp Portal, Ice Wall and Loki's Veil blocked even during MVP respawn downtime.

The dungeon guide lists all monster tiers, base EXP, retained rewards and respawn rules. This is the initial party-endgame balance profile; difficulty can be refined using party feedback.

docs.title: Main Office
docs.text:
The Main Office guide now brings together current directions, a numbered service map and all eleven office NPCs.

  • Enter at Prontera 164,167, beneath the Main Office bubble; arrive at main_office 127,38.
  • Leave through the 5x5 return portal centered on 127,41, which returns to Prontera 162,167. The outside entrance uses a 3x3 trigger.
  • Find Job Master, Kafra Services, Platinum Skills, Build Manager, Reset Girl, Gunslinger Supplies, Putty, Jackie, Enhanced Tool Dealer, Plagiarism Tutor and Salvia inside.
  • Service-name bubbles identify each NPC. Teleport and return items are disabled inside; use the doorway to leave.

docs.title: Character services
docs.text:
The Character Services guide now documents Job Master, Stylist and Healer:

  • Job Master is beside the Main Office landing at 122,38; the service map now shows eleven office NPCs.
  • Stylist is inside the Coin Exchange building at prt_in 43,114, with 42 hairstyles, nine hair colors and class-specific clothing colors.
  • Healer is at Prontera 152,187, offering free HP/SP recovery.

Job requirements, appearance options and healing settings are listed in the guide.

docs.title: Current NPC locations
docs.text:
Service Current location Job Master main_office 122,38 Stylist prt_in 43,114 Healer prontera 152,187 Build Manager main_office 118,32 Reset Girl main_office 118,28 Platinum Skill NPC main_office 118,36 Gunslinger Supplies main_office 136,35 Putty / Card Exchange main_office 136,32 Jackie / Ninja Supplies main_office 136,29 Plagiarism Tutor main_office 121,17 Salvia main_office 125,17 Gold Point Manager / Costume Shop prt_in 38,104 Lydia / Vestige Coin Exchange prt_in 38,108 Sister Elara / Baby Conversion prt_in 34,114 Merchants Warp / Market prontera 164,174 Card Remover prt_in 28,73

The Coin Exchange bubble at Prontera 133,183 marks the separate building for the Costume Shop, Lydia, Stylist and Sister Elara. The Market bubble at Prontera 164,174 marks Market Street access.

The class, dealer, build, coin and hourly-reward guides now use these locations. Card Removal documents the separate removal service, its fees and its existing failure outcomes.

docs.title: Novice Training Grounds
docs.text:
Every newly created character now starts in the Novice Training Grounds. Existing characters keep their current locations and progress.

  • Guided lessons cover controls, equipment, items, skills and combat.
  • Defeat five Porings, then complete at least one of six first-class practice lessons. These lessons do not lock the final class choice.
  • Graduate at Job Level 10 with a starter package of supplies, six equipment pieces and 10,000z, available once per character.
  • The 10,000z replaces Kafra Transportation tickets. Storage tickets remain part of the package.
  • Graduation sends you to Main Office 127,38 and saves your position there. Spend Basic Skill points, then visit Job Master at 122,38.
  • Training progress survives relogging. Combat Brade provides free recovery; training monsters give EXP and quest progress without loot, cards or Vestige Coins.

The dedicated guide contains the full reward catalogue, NPC locations, class-lesson hunts and graduation requirements. It is listed under Getting Started.

docs.title: Healer options
docs.text:
The Healer at Prontera 152,187 offers two paid recovery choices:

  • 1,000z: full HP and SP.
  • 10,000z: full HP and SP, plus Level 10 Blessing and Increase AGI for ten minutes.

The Character Services guide now reflects these options. Free tutorial recovery remains available through combat Brade while training.

docs.title: Warper
docs.text:
The Warper at Prontera 159,187 offers three travel categories:

Category Fee Nearby Midgard towns 2,000z Distant Midgard towns 3,600z New World 25,000z Islands 20,000z
  • Islands combines the former Foreign Lands categories into one menu.
  • Destination lists show the price. Selecting a destination charges its fee and warps immediately, without a separate confirmation.
  • New World towns remain hidden until that character completes Onward to the New World. El Dicastes also requires visitor registration, and Eclage requires immigration completion.
  • Access requirements explains outstanding quests. Previously completed quests are recognized automatically.
  • Jawaii is available for 3,600z, without marriage or quest requirements through the Warper.
  • Cancellation, insufficient Zeny and unavailable destinations do not charge a fee.

The dedicated guide lists all 34 destinations and their access rules under Getting Started.

docs.title: Pet System and evolution
docs.text:
The Pet System guide and illustrated catalogue now cover the active companion update:

  • 115 pet entries with pet pictures, food and accessory icons, auto-feed availability and owner bonuses by intimacy.
  • 43 evolution paths, with pictures and exact quantities for every ingredient.
  • Hunger decreases by 3 every 60 seconds; eligible pets support auto-feed. Owner death costs 5 intimacy, and starvation returns the pet to its egg at 1 intimacy.
  • Incubator cancellation preserves the active pet and item. Hatching and pet switching now complete correctly.
  • Evolution requires Loyal intimacy (900+), preserves a custom nickname and replaces the original egg with the evolved egg. New forms start at Neutral (250) with full hunger.
  • Listed rare egg drops use fixed final chances, unaffected by server rates or Bubble Gum.
  • Recipes use Drops Card, Vestige Coins and Skel-Bones for the approved classic-compatible substitutions.
  • Incubus keeps its existing server bonus. Blue Moon Loli Ruri's Kyrie effect uses a 5% physical-hit trigger.

The illustrated catalogue groups each base pet and its evolved forms side by side, with ingredient pictures, exact quantities and intimacy bonuses for comparison. On mobile, the cards stack in evolution order.

docs.title: Astrid's headgear quests
docs.text:
Astrid is available at Prontera 147,187: /navi prontera 147/187.

  • Craft 22 selected headgears using Vestige Coins and the listed materials.
  • Browse headgear pictures in her shop, select one and click Buy to open its requirements.
  • See owned/required counts, with missing materials in red and complete requirements in green.
  • Choose Purchase, try on the headgear with Preview, or Cancel. Previewing preserves equipment and bonuses and restores your normal appearance afterward.
  • Craft one headgear per purchase, with no Zeny fee. Equipped, refined, carded, favorite and other protected materials are not consumed.
  • Headgear names, descriptions and effects follow the configured quest catalogue. Crimson Rose has a fixed 1% chance to drop a Witherless Rose on a monster kill.

The Headgear Quests guide includes Astrid's picture and a three-column catalogue with headgear icons, illustrated ingredients, exact quantities and descriptions.

docs.title: Visual AFK Status
docs.text:
After 60 seconds idle on an eligible hunting map, an AFK sign replaces the upper-headgear appearance. Movement, attacks, skill use and item use clear it immediately. Equipment and its bonuses remain unchanged.

Towns and their interiors, autotrade, open vending/buying shops and WoE castle maps are excluded. See Visual AFK Status.

docs.title: Endless Tower
docs.text:
The Endless Tower party challenge is available through Captain Janssen at Prontera 217,187.

  • Start with six or more party members, each on a different account and Base Level 85+.
  • Gather on Misty Island. The leader starts at the Tower Protection Stone and everyone confirms !ready in public chat within 60 seconds.
  • Receive one run per account per week, shared across characters. Reset is Monday at 06:00 Philippines time. Readiness failures do not consume a run.
  • Climb the floors within four hours, without floor skipping. Only the original starting characters can rejoin the party's current floor while someone remains inside.
  • The tower closes when every original member leaves or disconnects. The weekly allowance remains consumed.
  • Personal/Guild Storage is blocked inside; RODEX remains available. Bubble Gum does not increase tower drops.
  • Defeat Naght Sieger and exit through Lost Soul to record completion. Individual party-member reports show damage, healing, deaths and monster kills near the exit.
  • Lost Soul combines the two Twin Edge of Naght Sieger swords into Violet Fear.

The guide includes monster sprites, IDs and quantities in a table for every floor, including Floor 99's random groups, Entweihen Crothen's thorn spawns and the final encounter waves.

docs.title: Endless Cellar
docs.text:
The Endless Cellar is available at the Cellar Protection Stone, Misty Island 82,110.

  • Descend 77 floors, following the Tower rooms in reverse and finishing in the final Tower arena.
  • Enter with six or more party members, all Base Level 85+. Everyone confirms !ready in public chat within 60 seconds before the four-hour run begins.
  • Receive one Cellar run per account per week, separate from Endless Tower. Both reset Monday at 06:00 Philippines time.
  • Original starting characters can rejoin the current floor while another original member remains inside. Personal/Guild Storage is blocked; RODEX remains available.
  • Wounded Morroc and reduced-drop final encounters use 10% of normal configured drop rates. The two randomly selected Bio Labs MVPs retain their normal rates.
  • The finale progresses through Poring, two Bio Labs MVPs, Super Baphomet with Piamettes/Wish Maidens, and Pori Pori with its final wave.
  • After the clear, claim through Arc Pori Pori within the five-minute exit window. Each original member receives one Old Card Album, Bloody Branch, Jewelry Box, Poring Box and Cookie Bag, together through RODEX.
  • Party-member copies at the exit show individual damage, healing, deaths and monster kills.

The guide includes 77 illustrated floor tables with monster sprites, IDs, quantities and the final-stage selection rules.

docs.title: Horror Toy Factory
docs.text:
The Horror Toy Factory is available through Catherine Jet Johnson at Lutie 237,303, with Mister Cat's Bloody Coin shop at Lutie 240,300.

  • Enter with three or more party members, each using a different account and Base Level 90+. Everyone confirms !ready in public chat within 60 seconds.
  • Receive one HTF run per account per week, separate from Tower and Cellar. Reset: Monday at 06:00 Philippines time.
  • Complete four areas within one hour: the production line, ten workers' memories, Antonio and the Kimi/phantom encounter.
  • Use Red Cookie and Myst Case disguises to progress through the factory.
  • Monsters and bosses use a Classic Pre-Renewal balance profile. Kimi and her phantom each have 6,666,666 HP. Their proximity, uneven-HP healing and room-reset mechanics reward coordinated damage.
  • Original starting characters may rejoin while someone remains inside. Personal/Guild Storage is blocked; RODEX remains available.
  • Ten shared treasure chests provide Bloody Coins and fixed-chance rewards after the boss clear. Use the final exit portal to record completion.
  • Mister Cat offers 11 equipment, costume and supply rewards for Bloody Coins.

The guide includes 24 illustrated item descriptions, exact chest chances and coin prices, area populations and tables for all 11 monster/boss profiles, including Celine Kimi's MVP encounter.

docs.title: Misty Island travel and services
docs.text:
• Complete the first voyage with Captain Janssen to unlock Misty Island - 5,000z in the Warper.
  • The island Kafra Employee provides Main Storage, Guild Storage and return to Prontera.
  • The Tower and Cellar Protection Stones offer run creation, current-floor re-entry and weekly run information. @instanceinfo shows both account allowances.

docs.title: Monster drops and combat
docs.text:
• Added the illustrated Monster Changes catalogue, with monster sprites, reward icons, item IDs and exact drop chances.
  • Applied 39 fixed final loot chances, including equipment, pet-taming items and Valkyrie Randgris Egg. Server-rate and personal drop boosts do not increase these listed chances.
  • Removed Yggdrasil Leaf from Evil Druid's drops.
  • Changed the six regular Bio Labs 3 monsters to whole-map spawns, preserving their totals and respawn times. These monsters are not protected by Kill Steal Protection.
  • Made monster Critical Slash Neutral element.
  • Added Classic definitions for Boitata Hat [1], Valkyrie Drop [1] and Old Mitra [1].

docs.title: Items and equipment services
docs.text:
• Added the illustrated Item Changes comparison: 124 item entries, with original mechanics beside our configured effects, requirements and acquisition rules.
  • Updated Classic weapon effects, armor eligibility, Temporal Boots and card effects, including Queen Scaraba's hard-MDEF damage scaling.
  • Added four refined-weapon conversion services, six socket upgrades, additional High Grade Armor enchants and BioShop at lhz_dun01 142,289.
  • Added Blood Thirst drops to the seven regular Bio Labs 4 monsters, providing the currency chain for Ghost Chill equipment purchases.
  • Added Mercury Riser to Baphomet (#1399) at a 5.1% fixed final chance.
  • Set persistent cooldowns of 60 minutes for Convex Mirror and 15 minutes for Token of Siegfried resurrection use.
  • Forging hammers and cooking kits are consumed when a craft is attempted; cancelling their selection window keeps the tool.
  • Added bulk Cursed Water and Guarana transactions, Holy Arrow packing and a uniform 39-accessory Pet Accessory Box.
  • The same +150% Bubble Gum is used by Lydia and the Card Exchange.
